headline: 5 Ethereum governance/admin addresses confirmed on-chain; 11 DAO multisig owner EOAs surfaced; multi-chain protocol contract addresses not extractable (JS-rendered docs, GitHub blocked)

findings.text: D1: Block-explorer name-tag search not executable — etherscan.io search API pages were not fetched this run (GitHub blocked, no etherscan fetch attempted). All 5 address_book entries confirmed via DeFiPunkd surfacers (on-chain read). Recorded as D1-offchain gap in unknowns.

D2: Canonical deployment addresses page confirmed at https://docs.balancer.fi/developer-reference/contracts/deployment-addresses/mainnet.html — but page content is JS-rendered; actual contract addresses are loaded dynamically and not present in fetched HTML. Deployment tasks repo linked at https://github.com/balancer/balancer-deployments/tree/master/v3/tasks but GitHub access is blocked. deployed_contracts_doc set to docs URL.

D3: No audit_links provided in per-protocol context. Docs security page confirms audits are published at https://github.com/balancer/balancer-v3-monorepo/tree/main/audits and that Immunefi bug bounty exists. GitHub access blocked so audit PDF contents cannot be walked this run. Immunefi URL confirmed from docs: https://immunefi.com/bounty/balancer/.

D4: GitHub (github.com) is blocked — 'You don't have permission to access this domain'. No deployment artifacts (broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy JSON, deployments.md) could be retrieved. Zero addresses from GitHub this run.

D5: Protocol.chains includes Ethereum, Monad, Arbitrum, Hyperliquid L1, Base, Avalanche, Optimism, Plasma, xDai. Docs sidebar confirms deployment pages exist for Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Gnosis (xDai), HyperEVM (Hyperliquid L1), Monad, Optimism, Plasma. All are JS-rendered with zero addresses extractable. GitHub blocked. Only Ethereum addresses confirmed on-chain. All non-Ethereum chains recorded in unknowns.

D6: No factory addresses were confirmed on-chain this run (the V3 Vault address itself is unconfirmed from fetched evidence). Docs describe WeightedPoolFactory and StablePoolFactory as core factories. Contract Registry on-chain registry exists for factory enumeration but its address is unknown from fetched sources. Factory discovery deferred to next run pending address confirmation.

D7: Role taxonomy applied — Authorizer (role-based ACL), multisig (6-of-11 DAO governance), timelock, guardian (Emergency SubDAO), protocol fee controller, and 11 EOA signer addresses catalogued. Actor classes assigned per evidence.

D8: All 5 address_book entries backed by DeFiPunkd surfacer fetches. 11 DAO multisig owner EOAs backed by defipunkd on-chain read of getOwners(). Safe implementation address backed by same surfacer. No snippet-only sightings in admin_addresses.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the protocol website, 2 DeFiPunkd surfacer pages, docs deployment/security/contract-registry pages, and conducted 1 web search. Confirmed 5 Ethereum governance/admin addresses on-chain, surfaced 11 DAO multisig owner EOAs, and identified metadata (GitHub repos, bug bounty, forum, audit location). Multi-chain addresses (Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche, Optimism, Monad, Plasma, xDai, Hyperliquid) not recoverable this run due to JS-rendered docs and blocked GitHub access. Total: 17 addresses catalogued (5 protocol admin + 11 multisig signers + 1 Safe impl), all Ethereum.

Canonical Balancer V3 deployment addresses page for Ethereum mainnet confirmed at this URL. Sections include Core Contracts, Routers, Pool Factories, Hooks and Peripherals, Authorization Contracts, Gauges and Governance. Content is JS-rendered (addresses load dynamically). Deployment tasks referenced at https://github.com/balancer/balancer-deployments/tree/master/v3/tasks.

Security page confirms: (1) bug bounty at https://immunefi.com/bounty/balancer/, (2) audits published at https://github.com/balancer/balancer-v3-monorepo/tree/main/audits, (3) core V3 contracts designed as immutable (no proxy upgrades), (4) Balancer x Certora Security Accelerator active since Oct 2022. Bounties apply only to protocol smart contracts.

Balancer Contract Registry is an on-chain registry tracking trusted Balancer contracts (POOL_FACTORY, ROUTER, HOOK, ERC4626 types). Aliases registered: WeightedPool→WeightedPoolFactory, StablePool→StablePoolFactory, Router→Router v2, BatchRouter→BatchRouter. Governance can update alias targets. Registry address not specified in this page.

Protocol website confirms Balancer is 'DeFi's most extensive AMM product suite' delivering 'fungible and yield-bearing liquidity across Ethereum and select EVM chains'. Capability probe: website fetched successfully (metadata only, JS-rendered body).

protocol_metadata.about: Balancer V3 is a programmable AMM protocol that allows users to swap tokens and provide liquidity across weighted, stable, and custom pool types on Ethereum and multiple EVM chains. Liquidity providers deposit assets into pools governed by configurable invariants (e.g. constant-product weighted pools, StableSwap), receiving fungible BPT receipts in return. V3 introduces a unified Vault architecture with hooks for custom pool behavior, a Contract Registry for trusted router/factory enumeration, and yield-bearing liquidity support via ERC4626 wrappers. Governance is conducted through a Balancer DAO (6-of-11 multisig) acting through an Authorizer contract that controls all permissioned protocol actions.
